newsitem.title: USA: Index of Leading Texas Economic Indicators.
newsitem.headline: Index of Leading Texas Economic Indicators.

text.p: John Sharp, Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, released the latest Index of Leading Texas Economic Indicators, which is at 130, a 2.6 percent increase compared to one year ago.
"The Texas economy has everthing going for it right now", Sharp said.
The Texas unemployment is down 0.3 percent from last year. The Texas Stock Index rose to 352.5 in May, 52.9 percent higher than one year ago.
Consumer confidence up 8.9 percent from the previous month and up 19.2 percent from last year.
The Texas Help Wanted Index rose 8.1 pecent compared to last year and new business incorporations are up 4.1 percent.
Only one indicator fell. The price of crude oil is down 1.7 pecent from last year and sold at $18.50 per barrel in May.
